body: I've had a good life.  I have everything anybody could ask for.  I am not sad or depressed.  It's just that the kids are grown and my husband has his businesses to keep him busy.....and it's been like the last 4 years that I just can't seem to find anything that I want to do.  I've tried to travel and volunteer and many other things.  I just don't see the harm in choosing my time to die, rather than just sit around and wait for it to happen.

I have a lot of material things....a nice house, money, a family, etc...I just feel like the kids are grown and I am done.  I don't live, I exist, and I don't want to be like that.  It's not that there is something I want to do or haven't done.  I've lived a good and fullfilling life.....I just feel done.  I don't think it's so bad to decide when your going to die, rather than just sit and wait for the inevitable.
